保留近 3 秒 · 可暂停查看: Keeps the last 3 seconds · pause to inspect
显示处理后送出的信号，不代表游戏实际视角。观察模式只模拟输出；新参数需应用后才会: Shows processed output signals, not the actual in-game camera. Observation mode simulates output; apply new settings to see their effect here.
操作手柄后显示波形: Operate the controller to see the waveform
累计位移从当前窗口起点计数；曲线越陡，移动越快。: Cumulative movement starts at the visible window origin; a steeper curve means faster motion.
位移速度按 8 ms 分段统计；可观察停顿和拖尾，短于分段的变化会合并。: Movement rate uses 8 ms buckets. Pauses and tails are visible; changes shorter than a bucket are combined.
幅度固定为 ±100%；平台表示持续推杆，回到 0 表示回中。: Fixed ±100% scale. A plateau means held stick output; returning to 0 means centered.
鼠标：X 正向右，Y 正向下。: Mouse: positive X is right, positive Y is down.
摇杆：X 正向右，Y 正向上。: Stick: positive X is right, positive Y is up.
